title: Justly Jazzy Jewel-Toned Dutch Pancakes Bake
description: Savory, snappy Dutch pancakes with rose water and a crunchy texture, best enjoyed as a delicious breakfast or brunch option. This Jain-friendly recipe uses an air fryer for a healthier twist.

ingredients.name: ricotta cheese
ingredients.notes: make sure it's jain-friendly by choosing a non-animal rennet variety or a store-bought brand that's vegan-friendly

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: non-dairy milk works great as well for a jain-friendly option

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, ricotta cheese, eggs, milk, rose water, salt, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice until smooth.
Add the melted butter to the bowl and whisk until combined.
Using a 1/4-cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the air fryer basket, leaving about 1 inch of space between each pancake.
Cook the pancakes for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and crispy.
Transfer the pancakes to a serving plate and garnish with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Drizzle with your favorite sauce, such as maple syrup or hollandaise.
Make sure to not overcrowd the air fryer, cook the pancakes in batches if necessary.
Wipe the air fryer basket clean with a paper towel before cooking each batch.
For a crisper exterior and a fluffier interior, make sure to not stir the batter too much.
If you don't have an air fryer, you can cook the pancakes in a non-stick skillet on the stovetop over medium heat for about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Keep in mind that cooking time may vary depending on the size of your pancakes.
If you want a more caramelized exterior, increase the cooking time by 1-2 minutes on each side.
